description: Agent-authored case review, including independent SUT-source evidence.
prompt_notes: source_verification is mandatory and must come from an independent read of product source

source_verification.independent must be true; source_verification.reviewed_source_files must list product source; source_verification.verified_claims must be non-empty; each verified_claims[].claim and verified_claims[].evidence_files must be non-empty
QA artifacts, requirements, docs, and tests do not count as product source evidence

minimum_coverage is a projection of trace/minimum-coverage-matrix.yaml: count only required rows; covered counts status=covered; skipped_by_scope and missing must list every required skipped row in matrix order
each findings item requires id, severity, category, message, and locator
for case.yaml automatic repairs locator.key is one dotted field path or multiple comma-separated dotted field paths; use steps,assertions, never steps/assertions
